performanceDiagnostics.scope: Raw instrumented emulator CPU/PSS and stage events; excludes fixture-process CPU/PSS. Not screenshots or device performance acceptance.

jvm.reason: JVM tests have no device UI

scope: Fixed segmented-stress diagnostic only: one selected test per API. Other suite tests were not selected and receive no passing status; this cannot replace a full regression. This fixed diagnostic plans 30 segments per dedicated emulator, each at least 60 seconds and including one completed synthetic task, one pending-approval stop and at least 10 seconds of service-off recovery. The numeric denominator is 240 planned segments and 480 planned tasks across eight APIs, separate from eight selected cases. Only atomically committed segment files are collected; incomplete, failed and absent measurements remain explicit. The measured resident Agent process includes instrumentation and the local model, excludes Fixture resources, and does not establish CPU saturation, leak absence, system-wide stability or physical-device performance budgets.
